unsupported_mechanic.ability_reference: FD10/002: when your opponent's cards would attack, change the target of the attack to this card.
unsupported_mechanic.what_is_known: Continuous passive attack redirection forcing all opponent attack declarations to target this monster while duo condition is met.
information_needed: Approved schema for passive attack target redirection (e.g. REDIRECT_ATTACK_TARGET).

en.plain:
[Call Cost] [Pay 1 life]
[Duo] "Chaos Wizard, Aurora" This card gets defense+5000, and when your opponent's cards would attack, change the target of the attack to this card.
[An/Turn] "Avaricious One of the Apocalypse" When this card is put into the drop zone from the field, draw a card and heal 1 life!
[Double Attack] [Penetrate]
